review.notes: Full line-by-line comparison of the OCR Markdown against extracted text from all 7 physical PDF pages; code-fence scan found no fences. Physical pages 2, 3, 4 and 6 were rendered (120-125 dpi) to verify repairs: the page-2 running header "Gemini 3.5 Flash - Model Card", the equal-level printed section headings "Implementation and Sustainability" and "Distribution", the seven-item Distribution bullet list, the whole benchmark table on page 4 (printed as a figure image with no text layer; every benchmark label, harness/setting label and score value was read from the render and matches the OCR values), and the Tone footnote at the bottom of page 6. The benchmark-table cell labels are flattened multi-line cells (OCR dropped cell-boundary spaces); the repair style follows the reviewed sibling cleanup reader-content/google/gemini-3-6-flash-model-card/cleanup.json (insert spaces, restore dropped sentences via anchored replacement, normalize heading level and the mixed bullet list). The trailing URL line under the benchmark table is printed in the source and kept.
